research_question: How did zero develop as a number and place-value symbol?

sources.title: Zero
sources.reliability: University of St Andrews mathematics-history reference
notes: Zero developed through several stages: placeholder use, a number in its own right, and rules for arithmetic. Avoid presenting it as a single invention by one person.

sources.title: Brahmagupta
sources.reliability: University of St Andrews mathematics-history reference
notes: Brahmagupta's 628 CE work gave arithmetic rules involving zero and negative numbers, while some rules involving division by zero were not correct by modern standards.

sources.title: The Bakhshali Manuscript
notes: The manuscript contains a dot used as a placeholder; dating its different layers is complex, so it should not be casually called the first modern zero.
